meta.title: Pricing — Palsya
meta.description: Seven days free, then three-month plans: app only, or with two or six video consultations. No countdowns, cancel in two clicks.

hero.title: Seven days free, then three months
hero.lead: Nothing is pre-selected, there is no countdown, and the middle option is marked as most chosen because it is, not to steer you.

card.startTrial: Start {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} free

app.name: App only
app.forWho: For people who want the structure and are already under the care of a clinician they can ask questions of.

features.programme: Full guided programme, all five stages
features.sessions: Daily sessions with taping and exercise guidance
features.support: Email support within one working day

guided.name: App + 2 consultations
guided.forWho: The one most people choose. Two calls is usually enough to catch the mistakes that matter — taping tension, effort level, and synkinesis appearing.

features.consults: Two 30-minute video consultations with a facial rehabilitation specialist
features.notes: Written notes and a plan after each call
features.adjusted: Your programme adjusted by a clinician, not only by the algorithm
features.priority: Priority support within four working hours

supported.name: App + 6 consultations
supported.forWho: For more complex cases: significant synkinesis, post-surgical recovery, slow early progress, or anyone who simply wants regular contact with a person.

features.consults: Six 30-minute video consultations — roughly every two weeks
features.continuity: Continuity with the same clinician throughout
features.messages: Direct message thread with your clinician

rows.share: Share reports with your own clinician

extension.title: After the first three months
extension.body: Extend month to month at {price}, or stop. Most people in Stage 4 or 5 extend for two or three months and then move to a short maintenance routine on their own.

consult.title: Extra consultations
consult.body: {price} each, on any plan. Booked from your account, usually available inside three days.

referral.title: Referred by a clinician?
referral.body: {discount, number, percent} off your first three months. Enter their referral code at checkout — it also lets them see your progress reports, if you agree to that separately.

reducedCost.title: If cost is the problem
reducedCost.body: Write to us. We hold a number of reduced-cost places each month for people who cannot afford this, and you will not be asked to prove anything beyond a sentence about your situation.
